words.sentenceCn: 这个湖变成了一个干旱之地。

words.sentenceCn: 骑自行车时戴头盔是合适的。
words.roots: ap+propri(自己的)+ate → 据为己有 / 恰当的

words.sentence: The glass was full to the brim.
words.sentenceCn: 这个玻璃杯被装得满满的。

words.sentenceCn: 他们向统治国家的君主鞠躬。

words.sentence: The badger dug a deep hole under the fence.
words.sentenceCn: 獾在栅栏下挖了一个深洞。

words.sentenceCn: 我们必须立刻解决这个问题。

words.sentenceCn: 那位著名演员在电影里短暂客串。

words.sentence: She refused to acknowledge her mistake.
words.sentenceCn: 她拒绝承认自己的错误。
words.roots: ac+knowledge(知道) → 承认

words.sentenceCn: 他面临说真话还是保持沉默的两难。

words.sentence: The young player has great potential.
words.sentenceCn: 这位年轻球员很有潜力。
words.roots: potent(有力的)+ial → 潜在的力量

words.sentence: The residents complained about the noise.
words.roots: resid(居留)+ent(人) → 居民

words.sentence: Our departure was delayed by the storm.
words.sentenceCn: 我们的出发被暴风雨耽搁了。
words.roots: depart(离开)+ure(名词) → 离开

words.sentence: The cherry trees blossom in spring.
The famine forced many people to flee.
words.roots: fam(饿)+ine → 饥荒

words.sentence: Medical ethics guide a doctor's decisions.
words.sentenceCn: 医学伦理指导医生的决定。
words.roots: eth(品行)+ics(学) → 伦理学

words.sentence: They held a great feast to celebrate.
That is precisely what I meant.
words.roots: precise(精确的)+ly → 精确地

words.sentence: We will meet again in a fortnight.
words.roots: fort(十四)+night → 十四夜 = 两周

words.sentence: The garden was fragrant with roses.
words.roots: fragr(香)+ant → 芳香的

words.sentence: She showed genuine concern for others.
words.sentenceCn: 她对他人表现出真诚的关心。
words.roots: gen(生)+uine → 天生的 = 真正的

words.sentence: A deep melancholy settled over him.
words.sentenceCn: 一种深深的忧郁笼罩着他。
words.roots: melan(黑)+choly(胆汁) → 黑胆汁 = 忧郁

words.sentence: The next few days are critical to the plan.
words.sentenceCn: 接下来几天对计划至关重要。
words.roots: crit(判断)+ical → 批判的 / 关键的

words.sentence: She is a renowned scientist.
words.sentenceCn: 她是一位著名的科学家。
words.roots: re+nown(名声) → 有名的

words.sentence: We need to coordinate our efforts.
words.sentenceCn: 我们需要协调各自的努力。
words.roots: co(共同)+ordin(次序)+ate → 使同序 = 协调

words.sentence: The store sells a wide range of merchandise.
words.sentenceCn: 这家店销售各种各样的商品。
words.roots: merch(交易)+andise → 商品

words.sentence: The two leaders held a constructive dialogue.
words.sentenceCn: 两位领导人进行了建设性对话。
words.roots: dia(之间)+logue(说) → 之间说话 = 对话

words.sentence: The region has abundant natural resources.
words.sentenceCn: 这个地区有丰富的自然资源。
words.roots: abund(涌流)+ant → 涌流的 = 丰富的

words.sentence: She gave a candid account of the events.
words.sentenceCn: 她坦率地叙述了事情经过。
words.roots: cand(白)+id → 清白的 = 坦率的

words.sentence: The company reported a large deficit.
words.roots: de(否定)+fic(做)+it → 做得不够 = 不足

words.meaning: 精心制作的,复杂的;v. 详述
words.sentence: He gave an elaborate explanation.
words.roots: e+labor(劳动)+ate → 费工的 = 精心的

words.sentence: The crowd grew hostile toward the speaker.
words.sentenceCn: 人群对演讲者变得充满敌意。
words.roots: host(敌人)+ile → 敌对的

words.sentence: Change is inevitable in any organization.
words.sentenceCn: 任何组织中变革都不可避免。
words.roots: in(不)+evit(避开)+able → 不可避开的

words.sentence: Selling software can be a lucrative business.
words.sentenceCn: 卖软件可能是很赚钱的生意。
words.roots: lucr(利润)+ative → 有利可图的

words.sentence: The area is notorious for crime.
words.sentenceCn: 这个地区因犯罪而臭名昭著。
words.roots: not(知道)+orious → 广为人知的(贬)

words.meaning: 晦涩的,模糊的;v. 遮蔽
words.sentence: The meaning of the poem remains obscure.
words.sentenceCn: 这首诗的含义依然晦涩。
words.roots: ob+scur(覆盖) → 被盖住的 = 模糊的

words.meaning: 似乎合理的,貌似可信的
words.sentence: His excuse sounded plausible enough.
words.sentenceCn: 他的借口听起来足够可信。
words.roots: plaus(鼓掌)+ible → 可获掌声的 = 可信的

words.sentence: He was reluctant to admit the truth.
words.roots: re(反)+luct(挣扎)+ant → 挣扎着的 = 不情愿的

words.sentence: The plan came under close scrutiny.
words.sentenceCn: 这个计划受到了严格审查。
words.roots: scrut(检查)+iny → 审查

words.meaning: 有形的,可触摸的;确凿的
words.sentence: We need tangible evidence, not guesses.
words.sentenceCn: 我们需要确凿的证据,而不是猜测。
words.roots: tang(接触)+ible → 可触的 = 有形的

words.sentence: She took vigorous exercise every morning.
words.sentenceCn: 她每天早上做剧烈运动。
words.roots: vig(活力)+orous → 精力充沛的

words.sentence: Much to his chagrin, he was beaten by the younger boy.
words.sentenceCn: 让他非常懊恼的是,他输给了更小的男孩。

words.sentence: Her frugal lifestyle helped her save a fortune.
words.sentenceCn: 她节俭的生活方式帮她攒下了一大笔钱。
words.roots: frug(果实)+al → 有果实的 = 节俭有余

words.sentence: He kept meticulous records of every experiment.
words.sentenceCn: 他为每个实验都保存了细致的记录。
words.roots: metic(害怕)+ulous → 因怕错而细致

words.sentence: The instructions were so ambiguous that no one understood them.
words.sentenceCn: 说明如此含糊,以至于没人看得懂。
words.roots: ambi(两边)+gu(走)+ous → 两边走 = 模棱两可

words.sentence: The benevolent old man donated all his savings.
words.sentenceCn: 那位仁慈的老人捐出了全部积蓄。
words.roots: bene(好)+vol(意愿)+ent → 好意的 = 仁慈的

words.sentence: Her red coat made her conspicuous in the crowd.
words.sentenceCn: 她的红大衣让她在人群中很显眼。
words.roots: con+spic(看)+uous → 大家都看得到 = 显眼的

words.sentence: A diligent student, she never missed a class.
words.sentenceCn: 作为一个勤奋的学生,她从不缺课。
words.roots: di+lig(选择)+ent → 用心选择去做 = 勤勉

words.sentence: The lawyer gave an eloquent closing argument.
words.sentenceCn: 律师作了雄辩的结案陈词。

words.sentence: They faced a formidable opponent in the final.
words.sentenceCn: 他们在决赛中面对一个强大的对手。
words.roots: formid(害怕)+able → 令人害怕的 = 令人敬畏的

words.sentence: He remained indifferent to their complaints.
words.sentenceCn: 他对他们的抱怨依旧漠不关心。
words.roots: in(不)+different(不同)→ 觉得没差别 = 漠不关心

words.sentence: The machine is in perpetual motion.
words.sentenceCn: 这台机器处于永不停歇的运动中。
words.roots: per(始终)+pet(寻求)+ual → 始终不停 = 永久的

words.sentenceCn: 孩子们往往有着惊人的恢复力。
words.roots: re(回)+sil(跳)+ient → 弹回来 = 有韧性的

words.sentenceCn: 填这些表格是件枯燥乏味的差事。
words.roots: ted(厌倦)+ious → 令人厌倦的 = 乏味的

words.sentence: A versatile tool that can do many jobs.
words.sentenceCn: 一件能干许多活的多用途工具。
words.roots: vers(转)+atile → 能转向多方 = 多才多艺的

words.sentence: Be wary of deals that sound too good.
words.sentenceCn: 对听起来太美好的交易要保持警惕。

words.sentenceCn: 他是这项改革的狂热支持者。
words.roots: zeal(热情)+ous → 满怀热情的 = 狂热的

articles.title: 7-Eleven Sues Nike Over Similar Stripe Design
articles.titleCn: 7-Eleven 起诉耐克:球鞋配色涉嫌商标侵权

body.en: 7-Eleven has filed a lawsuit in a federal court in Texas, accusing the sportswear giant of borrowing the convenience-store chain's well-known orange, green and red stripe design for an upcoming Air Max 95 sneaker.
body.cn: 7-Eleven 已在得州联邦法院提起诉讼,指控这家运动服饰巨头为即将推出的 Air Max 95 球鞋盗用了该便利店连锁标志性的橙、绿、红三色条纹设计。

body.en: In a lawsuit filed on July 1 in Dallas, 7-Eleven argued that the sneaker features a "confusingly similar imitation" of its tri-color branding, which has appeared for decades on store signs, advertising materials, merchandise and other products.
body.cn: 在 7 月 1 日于达拉斯提起的诉讼中,7-Eleven 主张该球鞋呈现出对其三色品牌标识"令人混淆的相似模仿",而这一标识数十年来出现在店招、广告物料、商品等各处。

body.en: The convenience-store chain claims that the resemblance is so strong that ordinary shoppers might reasonably believe the shoe was produced in an official partnership between the two brands, or that 7-Eleven had somehow approved the design.
body.cn: 这家便利店连锁声称,二者的相似度如此之高,以至于普通消费者可能会合理地相信,这款鞋是两个品牌官方合作的产物,或者 7-Eleven 曾以某种方式批准了该设计。

body.en: According to the complaint, the company had reached out to the sportswear maker before taking legal action, but the two sides failed to arrive at an agreement. 7-Eleven is now seeking to block the release of the sneaker and to recover damages.
body.cn: 根据诉状,该公司在采取法律行动之前曾与这家运动服饰厂商接洽,但双方未能达成一致。7-Eleven 现在寻求阻止这款球鞋上市,并索赔损失。

body.en: Legal experts note that trademark disputes over color combinations are notoriously difficult to win, since a brand must prove that consumers strongly associate a particular set of colors with its own identity rather than with the product category in general.
body.cn: 法律专家指出,围绕配色组合的商标纠纷向来极难胜诉,因为品牌必须证明:消费者会将某一组特定颜色与其自身身份强烈关联,而非与整个产品品类关联。

body.en: For now, the sportswear giant has declined to comment on the pending litigation, while sneaker enthusiasts online remain divided over whether the striped design was a deliberate homage or simply a coincidence.
body.cn: 目前,这家运动服饰巨头拒绝就尚未了结的诉讼置评,而网上的球鞋爱好者们则对这条纹设计究竟是刻意致敬还是纯属巧合争论不休。

articles.title: Tencent Tests AI Assistant To Catch Up
articles.titleCn: 起步落后对手,小微能否扭转腾讯 AI 劣势?

body.en: Tencent is rolling out an upgraded AI assistant as it races to close the gap with domestic rivals in the fast-moving field of generative artificial intelligence.
body.cn: 腾讯正在推出升级版 AI 助手,以在快速演进的生成式人工智能领域追赶国内竞争对手。

body.en: The new assistant, deeply integrated into the company's messaging and payment ecosystem, is designed to answer questions, summarize documents and help users draft messages without leaving the apps they already use every day.
body.cn: 这款新助手深度集成到公司的即时通讯与支付生态中,旨在让用户无需离开他们每天使用的应用,就能获得问答、文档摘要和消息草拟等帮助。

body.en: Analysts say Tencent's greatest advantage lies not in the raw capability of its underlying model, but in its enormous user base, which gives any new feature an instant audience of hundreds of millions.
body.cn: 分析人士认为,腾讯最大的优势并不在于其底层模型的原始能力,而在于其庞大的用户群——这让任何新功能都能瞬间拥有数以亿计的受众。

body.en: Still, the company faces the delicate task of introducing AI features without overwhelming users or raising fresh concerns about privacy, a balance that has tripped up several of its competitors.
body.cn: 尽管如此,该公司仍面临一个微妙的难题:如何在不让用户感到负担、也不引发新的隐私担忧的前提下推出 AI 功能——这一平衡曾让它的数个竞争对手栽了跟头。

body.en: Whether Tencent can turn its late start into a lasting advantage will depend on how quickly it can iterate, and on whether users find the assistant genuinely useful rather than merely novel.
body.cn: 腾讯能否将其起步的迟缓转化为持久的优势,将取决于它迭代的速度,以及用户是否觉得这款助手真正有用,而非仅仅新奇。

articles.title: Why Do We Give Chocolate On Valentine's Day?
articles.titleCn: 巧克力为何成为情人节首选礼物?

body.en: The tradition of giving chocolate on Valentine's Day dates back to the 19th century, when a British chocolate maker began selling heart-shaped boxes filled with sweets.
body.cn: 情人节送巧克力的传统可追溯到 19 世纪,当时一家英国巧克力制造商开始出售装满糖果的心形礼盒。

body.en: Long before that, chocolate was considered a rare and precious luxury, reserved for royalty and the wealthy, and even believed by some to have romantic and medicinal powers.
body.cn: 而在更早之前,巧克力被视为稀有而珍贵的奢侈品,专供王室与富人享用,甚至有人相信它具有浪漫与药用的功效。

body.en: Clever advertising in the following century transformed the treat into a symbol of affection, until offering a box of chocolates became one of the most recognizable gestures of love.
body.cn: 在随后的一个世纪里,巧妙的广告将这种甜食塑造成情感的象征,直到送上一盒巧克力成为最易辨识的爱意表达之一。

body.en: Today, millions of boxes are exchanged each February, proof that a simple marketing idea can, over time, harden into a global custom that few of us ever stop to question.
body.cn: 如今,每年二月都有数以百万计的礼盒被交换,这证明了一个简单的营销创意,经过时间的沉淀,能固化为一项我们几乎从不停下来质疑的全球习俗。
